rules.rule: Check for urgent suspected TB conditions
rules.problem: Check task lists only symptoms and not vitals, and omits the management items (oxygen, ceftriaxone) from the red box; acceptable, but the trigger Tuberculosis possible comes from the box header 'suspected TB'.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible TB from TB symptoms, TB contact or abnormal screening CXR
rules.problem: Page also says to test for TB without symptoms in: DS-TB in last 2 years, PLHIV (at diagnosis/yearly), pregnant at first antenatal visit. These are omitted. Also the page's wording is 'check/test for TB', not 'likely', so possible is right but the abnormal-CXR and contact entries are screening indications not symptoms.

rules.rule: Urgent: suspected TB with danger signs
rules.problem: Structure (possible TB AND any of 15 signs) matches the red box; all 12 bullets covered with correct thresholds and directions. Minor imprecision for hemoptysis volume and unaided walking.

summary: The urgent rule is faithful in structure and thresholds (RR >= 30, pulse > 120, temp > 39). The main gap is that the diagnosis rule omits the asymptomatic-testing groups (previous DS-TB, PLHIV, pregnancy at first antenatal visit). Several concepts are slightly broader than the page: hemoptysis (volume dropped), unable to walk (unaided dropped), unable to complete a sentence (stricter than breathless while talking), and fever uses a different role (active_condition).
